system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast targeting a creature that is Grappled, Prone and Severed.

You target the nape of your targets neck, preparing to strike with a single swift and lethal swing. Make a melee taijutsu attack against the target creature dealing [Weapons Damage] + 10d6, rerolling 1’s and 2’s taking the second result.

Ideal Cut: For every 4, 5 or 6 you roll, using this jutsu’s damage dice, the target creature suffers a -1 penalty to their AC and saving throws, until the beginning of your next turn.

Tao: If this attack is 10 or higher than the targets AC, this attack is a critical hit and the affected creature suffers the effects of all 6 of the severed conditions effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
